Former CIA targeter Jihi Bustamante joins Danny Jones to argue for watching people inside the United States. The episode title puts her case in plain words: she backs surveillance of US citizens. She speaks from her years of targeting work.

Bustamante explains how targeters build files on people and why she thinks the tools keep the country safe. She faces the hard side of the claim, the rights of the people watched. Jones pushes on where the line should sit. Listeners hear a rare defense of domestic watch work from a woman who did it. The library files the talk as an archive record.

Writer Eric Czuleger joins Danny Jones to talk about ghost nations said to hide deep inside Europe. The episode title calls them mysterious peoples just found. Czuleger works on lost groups and the tales told about them.

Czuleger lays out the claims of small peoples who live apart and shun the world outside. He sifts old reports, maps, and travel tales for what might be true. Jones asks how much is myth grown over time. Listeners get a tour of a strange claim at Europe's core. The library holds the talk as an archive record for the curious.
